state.objective: Test concrete HO-unit postings and define count scenarios for 70 legacy affiliate accounts without assuming legal-entity status.
confirmed_facts: Finance and bank operations are centralized at HO.
Units may hold petty cash, cashier float and physical sales cash but cannot access bank accounts.
Units cannot transact directly with other units.
Natural accounts already use site_id rather than unit suffixes.
Legacy structure has 42 affiliate receivable and 28 affiliate payable families by named location and nature.
The legal-entity relationship remains the decisive missing fact.

Round 1 concluded: same-entity sites are not external AR/AP; separate entities should use counterparty_legal_entity_id; assets and liabilities cannot be automatically netted; zero inactive routes should not remain active; nonzero balances require traceable reclassification.
same_entity_examples: HO bank funds a unit petty-cash balance.
HO purchases goods that are shipped to a unit.
HO pays electricity or another expense attributable to a unit.
A unit deposits physical sales cash into a bank account controlled by HO.
state.separate_entity_candidate: Five provisional natures: affiliate receivable-financing, receivable-goods, receivable-other, payable-financing, payable-goods, with counterparty_legal_entity_id and elimination matching.

petty_cash_same_entity.instructions: For one legal entity, does HO funding unit petty cash normally require an affiliate receivable/payable pair?

criteria.no: Post movement between bank/cash accounts with site and cash-location detail; use temporary clearing only if timing requires it.
criteria.yes: Create permanent affiliate AR/AP for the unit.
criteria.income: Recognize income and expense between HO and unit.

goods_same_entity.instructions: For one legal entity, does shipping owned inventory from HO to a unit normally create affiliate sales, receivable and payable?

criteria.no: Use inventory transfer/in-transit workflow and site/item detail without internal sale or AR/AP.
criteria.yes: Recognize an affiliate sale and purchase for every shipment.
criteria.writeoff: Expense inventory when it leaves HO.

expense_same_entity.instructions: For one legal entity, when HO pays a unit-attributable utility expense, is affiliate receivable/payable normally necessary?

criteria.no: Post the natural expense with unit/cost-center attribution and the external bank/AP counterpart.
criteria.yes: Record permanent affiliate AR/AP between HO and unit.
criteria.no_unit: Do not attribute the expense to the unit.

sales_cash_same_entity.instructions: For one legal entity, does depositing unit sales cash into an HO-controlled bank account create affiliate receivable/payable?

criteria.no: Clear sales-cash/undeposited-funds to the actual bank account with site and deposit reference.

same_entity_active_count.instructions: If all four examples describe the actual same-entity process and there is no branch self-balancing requirement, what target is most defensible for the 70 permanent affiliate accounts?

criteria.zero_permanent: No permanent affiliate AR/AP accounts; retain legacy history and use only justified temporary clearing accounts outside this 70-family matrix.
criteria.five: Retain five permanent affiliate natures despite no separate counterpart entity.

same_entity_clearing_count.instructions: Can the required number of temporary clearing accounts be determined from the COA names alone?

criteria.no: Determine from actual timing gaps, workflows, reconciliation ownership and statement presentation.

separate_entity_five.instructions: If named units are actually separate legal entities and the five natures have aligned terms/reporting, is 70 to five a reasonable conditional target?

criteria.no: Keep every counterparty name in GL.
criteria.net: Use one net account for all five natures.

site_vs_entity.instructions: May site_id and legal_entity_id be treated as the same field automatically?

criteria.no: A legal entity can have many sites; keep explicit mapping and only require intercompany partner for separate entities.
criteria.yes: Every site is automatically a legal entity.

word_affiliate.instructions: Does the word Affiliasi in a legacy account prove the named site is a separate legal entity?

criteria.no: Verify legal name, ownership, tax registration and consolidation scope.
criteria.yes: The account label is conclusive legal evidence.

migration_sequence.instructions: What is the safest migration sequence for these 70 accounts?

criteria.audit_map_reclass: Classify legal entities/sites, inventory active accounts and balances, match counterpart entries, map valid natures, reclassify balances, reconcile, then deactivate legacy accounts.
criteria.merge: Merge balances mechanically into one account.

next_after_interunit.instructions: After the interunit legal-entity decision is documented, which previously competing domain should be reviewed next?

criteria.tax_prepaid_accrual: Review tax, prepaid schedules, accrued expenses and advances.

finality.instructions: Can Jev choose between zero permanent accounts and five intercompany natures without the legal-entity master and transactions?

criteria.no: The result must remain a two-scenario decision tree until client evidence is supplied.
criteria.yes: Choose one scenario from the account names.
